text: レッドと　いったな！

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と before いう shows the words that were said, here a name. レッドと　いった = 'you said you were called Red'.

patterns.name: 〜な (sentence end)
patterns.explanation: な at the end is a rough, manly way of checking or stressing, like ね but tougher. いったな = 'you said so, right'.
